*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: C:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\oaf_status.cmd
+@echo off
+setlocal
+
+set "ROOT=%~dp0"
+set "SCRIPT=%ROOT%.cursor\hooks\open-terminal-on-session-start.ps1"
+set "RUNNER=%ROOT%oaf.cmd"
+
+echo [oaf-status] root: "%ROOT%"
+
+if exist "%SCRIPT%" (
+  echo [oaf-status] hook_script: OK - "%SCRIPT%"
+) else (
+  echo [oaf-status] hook_script: MISSING - "%SCRIPT%"
+  exit /b 1
+)
+
+if exist "%RUNNER%" (
+  echo [oaf-status] runner: OK - "%RUNNER%"
+) else (
+  echo [oaf-status] runner: MISSING - "%RUNNER%"
+  exit /b 1
+)
+
+echo [oaf-status] probe: running oaf.cmd ...
+call "%RUNNER%"
+set "PROBE_EXIT=%ERRORLEVEL%"
+
+if "%PROBE_EXIT%"=="0" (
+  echo [oaf-status] probe_exit_code: 0 (healthy)
+) else (
+  echo [oaf-status] probe_exit_code: %PROBE_EXIT% (unhealthy)
+)
+
+exit /b %PROBE_EXIT%
*** End Patch

<user_query>
I ran a new agent and used the oaf function but still the Agent's step-by-step live feed of what it was doing didn't show up to the terminal
</user_query>

That behavior is expected with your current setup.

`oaf.cmd` only runs `.cursor\hooks\open-terminal-on-session-start.ps1`, and that script does two things:
- focuses Cursor + runs `Terminal: Focus Terminal`
- prints `{ "continue": true }`

It does **not** attach to an agent’s internal event stream or forward agent reasoning/step logs into the terminal. So you’ll see terminal output for shell commands, but not guaranteed “agent step-by-step” narration.

Why you didn’t see live step feed:
- Many agent steps use non-terminal tools (read/edit/search APIs), which produce no terminal output.
- Some agent status updates appear in chat UI only, not terminal.
- Focusing terminal only changes visibility, not telemetry routing.

If you want, I can walk you through a design for a true “agent activity mirror” (e.g., hook + log writer + polling tail) that would explicitly print phase markers to terminal in future runs.
